title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-Margined B2USDT and MILKUSDT Perpetual Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance Futures will launch the following perpetual contracts as below: 2025-05-06 13:30 (UTC):  B2USDT  Perpetual Contract with up to 50x leverage 2025-05-06 13:45 (UTC):  MILKUSDT  Perpetual Contract with up to 50x leverage Please note that B2 ( LINK ) and MILK ( LINK ) are already listed on Binance Alpha Market. More details on the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract B2USDT MILKUSDT Launch Time 2025-05-06 13:30 (UTC) 2025-05-06 13:45 (UTC) Underlying Asset B2 (BSquared Network) MILK (MilkyWay) Contract Address 0x783c3f003f172c6Ac5AC700218a357d2D66Ee2a2 0x7b4bf9feccff207ef2cb7101ceb15b8516021acd Project Info B² Network is a next-generation Layer2 scaling solution built on top of Bitcoin (BTC), aiming to significantly enhance Bitcoin’s performance and scalability without compromising its foundational security. MilkyWay is the first and largest liquid staking protocol for the modular ecosystem. Settlement Asset USDT USDT Tick Size 0.0001 0.00001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x 50x Trading Hours 24/7 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Supported Please Note:   The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  this FAQ . The maximum funding rate of the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned Futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the aforementioned perpetual contract(s).  The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) are subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Futures and spot token listings are  not correlated . A token listed on Binance Futures  does not guarantee  that it will be listed on Binance Spot.
